_draft.prepared_by: governor lane (no key, no signing, no submission)
_draft.owner_action: Owner replaces OWNER_ACCOUNT, autofills Fee/Sequence/LastLedgerSequence with their own client, reviews, signs and submits. Nothing here is on-ledger until that happens; the root witness sidecar keeps xrpl_memo NOT_YET until a validated tx hash is recorded.

subject.note: MemoData commits to sha256(root.json bytes) as served at fetched_at: the same subject the Rekor/OTS witness sidecar names. The live apex was serving an OLDER root than master at prep time (master public/root.json = 402f7b77…, as_of 2026-09-14T09:45:35Z). Re-fetch and regenerate MemoData immediately before signing if the live sha256 has moved.

_draft.memo_semantics: An XRPL memo proves only that this 32-byte digest was included in a validated ledger no later than that ledger's close time. It says nothing about when, how, or whether any measurement ran, and nothing about the meaning of the bytes.
_draft.why_accountset: AccountSet with none of its optional fields (ClearFlag/SetFlag/Domain/etc.) set is the smallest self-addressed transaction that can carry a Memo: no Destination, no value moved. The Payment alternative sends 1 drop to a second owner-controlled address; 'Amount' is the API v1 field name (API v2 clients use DeliverMax). Choose one, not both.
source_docs: https://xrpl.org/docs/references/protocol/transactions/common-fields (Memos Field: MemoData/MemoType/MemoFormat are hex Blob fields)

before_signing: curl -s https://councilof.ai/root.json | shasum -a 256   # must equal the MemoData below (lowercase) or regenerate
after_owner_submits: # PASS only if: validated == True, TransactionResult == tesSUCCESS, MemoData == sha256 of the root.json bytes named in subject
curl -s -X POST https://s1.ripple.com:51234 -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"method":"tx","params":[{"transaction":"<TX_HASH>"}]}'   # second, independent server must agree
curl -s -X POST https://xrplcluster.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"method":"ledger","params":[{"ledger_index":<LEDGER_INDEX>}]}'   # close_time_iso = the no-later-than bound
